## Summary

Describe the scientific or software problem and the change.

## Device/measurement semantics

State which technology, platform, terminal topology, mechanism, material, behavior, and experiment-profile axes are affected. Explain any nonstandard terminal definition.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation added or updated
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy src/memdevice_bench` passes
- [ ] Metric definitions, units, preprocessing, and failure behavior are explicit
- [ ] Multi-terminal energy does not substitute channel read conductance for programming-path current
- [ ] Dataset license and redistribution rights are verified, if applicable
- [ ] Synthetic data are labeled as software-test/tutorial data, if applicable

## Evidence

Provide plots, expected values, instrument documentation, wiring details, or literature references needed to review the change.
